title: M3: Shared control plane and one local worker

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR 1 of 3 (claim correctness) open: fencing tokens, real heartbeat renewal, fallback gate, per-day quota reset. Attempt timeouts and account-wide budget scope remain M4.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR 2 of 3 (video jobs and one worker) open, stacked on PR 1: job kind, video hash and dedupe, local-only waiting reason, content store for narration audio, unified worker with the TypeScript subprocess, video commands with --json and Fix lines, WorkerAuth seam for M2. Voices in the content store and auritus-03327e follow as PR 2b.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR 2b open (stacked on PR 2): cloned voices in the content-addressed store with the manifest published last, Batch downloads and verifies them, Higgs/Bark reject named voices. Also: the claimable list now carries voice_id, so a local worker no longer sees every job as the default voice.
